channel.title: Prankster News
channel.description: Prankster News delivers current breaking news across world, politics, business, technology, sports, and weather.

item.title: Your Pay Compared to the CEO's of Top US Companies
item.description: The typical S&P 500 CEO made $17.7 million in 2025, about 200 times the median worker. See CEO pay by industry and age, and what's driving the gap.

item.title: Hackers Leak Thousands of Chase Customer Emails After Attack on Bank's Outside Vendors
item.description: JPMorgan Chase says the stolen marketing data did not include card numbers and has nothing to do with Monday's outage that slowed payments at several banks.

item.title: Fiona the Hippo, the Cincinnati Zoo Preemie Who Won Over the World, Dies After Swallowing a Hat
item.description: The 9-year-old Nile hippo died Thursday, Nov. 19, after veterinarians spent days trying to help her pass a knit hat that was accidentally flung into her habitat.

item.title: Iran Targets U.S. Air Base in Kuwait and Sites in Bahrain as Tit-for-Tat Strikes Return to the Gulf
item.description: Kuwait and Bahrain said their air defenses intercepted the attacks, which came after U.S. aircraft struck an Iranian missile site on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: After a 13-Year Wait, 'Grand Theft Auto VI' Arrives With Enormous Hype and Near-Perfect Reviews
item.description: Rockstar Games' return to Vice City goes live at midnight local time on Thursday, Nov. 19, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, and players in New Zealand were among the first to start playing.

item.title: House Democrats Nominate Hakeem Jeffries for Speaker, Putting Him on Track to Be the First Black Speaker
item.description: Jeffries won the closed-door caucus vote 251-11. The full House will elect its speaker on Jan. 3, when Democrats take the majority.

item.title: Democrat Mary Peltola Unseats Sen. Dan Sullivan in Alaska, Giving Democrats a 56-44 Senate Majority
item.description: Peltola cleared 50% of the first-choice vote, so no ranked-choice count was needed. The former congresswoman will be the first Alaska Native in the Senate, and hers was the last Senate race of the midterms to be decided.

item.title: U.S. Loses Measles Elimination Status After 26 Years as Kennedy Vows to Win It Back
item.description: After a record year of cases, international health officials say the virus is spreading nonstop in the U.S. again. The administration says its response won't change, while critics fault its mixed messages on vaccines.

item.title: Chase Software Glitch Slows Transactions at Major U.S. Banks Before Service Returns to Normal
item.description: A bug in JPMorgan Chase's systems delayed transfers and Zelle payments for customers at several big banks on Monday.

item.title: Tech Leaders and Trump Back a Push to Reinstate Jensen Huang, but Nvidia's Board Isn't Budging
item.description: A petition to bring back Nvidia's ousted co-founder has drawn support from Elon Musk, other tech executives and President Trump, but the board is not considering his return.

item.title: Robert Pattinson Is Named the Seventh James Bond, Taking Over from Daniel Craig
item.description: The name's Pattinson. Robert Pattinson.

item.title: NFL Week 11 Matchups
item.description: Week 10 brought blowouts, a shootout and a long-awaited first win.

item.title: Public Office Is Not a Trading Desk: Congress Should Ban Itself from Playing the Market
item.description: A stock-trading ban for elected officials should be a common-sense law.

item.title: Man's Best Friend, Backed by Science: What Research Says About the Health Benefits of Owning a Dog
item.description: Dog owners have long said their pets make life better.

item.title: Meta in the Spotlight as Italy Fines €805 Million for Accessing Users' Photos Without Consent
item.description: Italy's data protection authority has fined Meta €805 million (about $887 million) after finding that the Facebook app for Android accessed photos, videos and their metadata on Italian users' phones without specific consent.

item.title: Trump, Xi and Putin to Meet in Shenzhen in First-Ever Three-Way Summit
item.description: The leaders of the world's three biggest nuclear powers plan to sit down together for the first time.

item.title: How Clean Gutters Can Protect Your Home
item.description: Routine gutter maintenance is one of the best ways to protect a home from water damage that can compromise its structure, exterior, and longevity.

item.title: The Price of Keeping a Democrat Majority in Congress
item.description: Democrats take control of both the House and Senate on January 3rd with a clear mandate on costs and the Iran war, but limited ability to force outcomes beyond a presidential veto.

item.title: Ukraine Russia Peace Talks in Abu Dhabi
item.description: Two days of U.S.-mediated talks between Ukraine and Russia in Abu Dhabi ended Wednesday with an agreement in principle on a large prisoner exchange.

item.title: House Republicans Come to Hegseth Rescue
item.description: House Republicans blocked a vote on impeaching Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Tuesday, 211–204.

item.title: The War in Gaza: Death Tolls, Humanitarian Conditions, the Genocide Question, and U.S. Support
item.description: The Gaza Health Ministry reports roughly 74,645 Palestinians killed as of mid-November 2026.

item.title: Details on Impeachment Articles Against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth
item.description: Rep. Thomas Massie introduced eight articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

item.title: FDA Requires New Warning on Rare Vision-Loss Risk for All GLP-1 Drugs
item.description: The FDA is requiring all GLP-1 drugs to add a warning about a rare risk of sudden vision loss.

item.title: NFL Week 10 Matchups
item.description: The Bills and the 49ers are the only teams with one loss, and the winless Chargers visit Baltimore.

item.title: Georgia Reclaims No. 1 as Playoff Picture Sharpens Amid Ohio State’s Collapse
item.description: Georgia is back at No. 1 after a 42-7 win at Ole Miss, while Ohio State has dropped to three losses.

item.title: Israel’s President Tasks Eisenkot, Not Netanyahu, with Forming the Next Government
item.description: Herzog asked Gadi Eisenkot, not Netanyahu, to try to form Israel’s next government.

item.title: Houston Mayor Limits Police Cooperation with ICE After Democratic Midterm Gains
item.description: Houston police will no longer call ICE on a routine stop that ends in a citation.

item.title: Trump Names Stephen Miller White House Chief of Staff, Replacing Susie Wiles After Midterm Losses
item.description: Trump named Stephen Miller chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles, and said the midterms were not the reason.

item.title: Digital Price Tags: Efficiency Tool or Path to Personalized Pricing?
item.description: Walmart, Kroger, and other retailers are swapping paper shelf tags for digital price screens.

item.title: The Russia-Ukraine War in Late 2026: Stalemate, Attrition, and Narrow Paths to De-escalation
item.description: Five years into the war, the front is mostly static while the human and economic costs keep rising.
